_comment: Drives the link-in-bio page at https://shauna.dev/links/ (src/pages/links.astro).
2026-09-26: the page is now ONE profile card, modelled on a microsite card:
a photo mosaic of recent work, the avatar overlapping it, name + verified
badge, tags, bio, status, location and two buttons. The old grouped link
GALLERY: add a project = add one entry to `gallery` and drop its image in
public/images/gallery/. The first three fill the mosaic (first = the big
tile); the third tile shows "+N" once there are more than three. Every
entry, shown on the card or not, is in the tap-to-open photo viewer.
Screenshots are 1440x900 JPEGs of each site's homepage. Keep that size so
the viewer does not jump between shapes.
